name: Watchman On The Wall
overview: The biblical role of the watchman is one of solemn responsibility, as God appoints watchmen to vigilantly guard His people by warning them of impending danger and calling them to faithfulness. Isaiah 62:6 emphasizes the watchmen's unceasing prayer and intercession for Jerusalem, while Ezekiel 3:17 and 33:6 highlight the accountability involved in faithfully sounding the alarm to prevent judgment. Amos 3:7 reveals that God communicates His plans through His servants, underscoring the prophetic nature of the watchman's duty. Finally, Luke 21:36 calls believers to spiritual vigilance and prayer, preparing to stand before Christ amid coming trials.
